en_title: Shift Up CEO Defends Stellar Blade: Blood Rain AI Music Video Against Player Backlash
cn_title: 剑星：Blood Rain AI宣传片惹争议
subtitle: AI这次翻车了？
opus_summary: Shift Up为《剑星：Blood Rain》发布AI音乐视频，主角Evie演唱跳舞，引发玩家批评角色失真并贬低美术劳动。CEO Kim Hyung Tae称AI只是基于团队创作进行呈现，玩家仍不买账。

不确定官方中文译名，保留英文

paragraphs.en: The CEO of Shift Up has responded to backlash surrounding the release of an AI-generated music video promoting Stellar Blade’s sequel game, Blood Rain.
paragraphs.cn: Shift Up首席执行官回应了围绕一支AI生成音乐视频的批评，该视频用于宣传《剑星》的续作《Blood Rain》。

paragraphs.en: The video, published on July 31, showed the game’s main character, Evie, singing and dancing to an upbeat pop song titled ‘Wanna be in Love.’ It’s very obviously AI-generated, containing all the signature tells of such content, including nonsensical written wording, inconsistencies in character models, and a blurred, airbrushed filter over it all.
paragraphs.cn: 这支于7月31日发布的视频展示了游戏主角伊薇伴随着一首名为《Wanna be in Love》的欢快流行歌曲唱歌跳舞。视频显然由AI生成，包含此类内容的各种典型痕迹，例如毫无意义的文字、角色模型前后不一致，以及覆盖全片的模糊磨皮滤镜。

paragraphs.en: This has soured players on the otherwise highly-anticipated title, prompting a harsh wave of criticism that warranted a response from developer Shift Up’s CEO, Kim Hyung Tae.
paragraphs.cn: 这让玩家对原本备受期待的作品大失所望，也引发了猛烈批评，迫使开发商Shift Up的CEO Kim Hyung Tae出面回应。

paragraphs.en: "Wanna be in LOVE" feat. EVIE from Stellar Blade : BLOODRAIN
paragraphs.cn: 《Wanna be in LOVE》：剑星：BLOODRAIN featuring EVIE

paragraphs.en: EVIE’s new music video is now available in YouTube. I would be very grateful if you could watch the video and share your thoughts! https://t.co/n1bhFiH1IJ #StellarBlade #BLOODRAIN #EVIE pic.twitter.com/eNiLyZAQ5W
paragraphs.cn: EVIE的新音乐视频现已在YouTube上线。如果你愿意观看视频并分享想法，我将不胜感激！https://t.co/n1bhFiH1IJ #剑星 #BLOODRAIN #EVIE pic.twitter.com/eNiLyZAQ5W

paragraphs.en: Speaking on X (formerly Twitter), Hyung Tae praised the artists responsible for the design of the game’s main character, Evie, arguing that an AI merely used their work to compile the scenes showing her dancing and singing rather than making anything on its own from scratch.
paragraphs.cn: Hyung Tae在X（原Twitter）上发文称赞了负责设计游戏主角伊薇的艺术家，并表示AI只是利用他们的作品，拼合出伊薇唱歌跳舞的场景，而不是凭空独立创作任何内容。

paragraphs.en: “EVIE, the character at the heart of this video, was created from head to toe by our talented artists and modelers through more than a year of dedicated work. The AI is not creating her from scratch. It is rendering and presenting the character based on the data, designs, and craftsmanship our team created. We would truly appreciate it if you could view the work with that understanding in mind,” he wrote.
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「EVIE是这支视频的核心角色，由我们才华横溢的艺术家和建模师经过一年多的专心工作，从头到脚打造而成。AI并非从零创造她，而是基于我们团队创作的数据、设计和工艺，对这个角色进行渲染与呈现。如果你能带着这样的理解观看这部作品，我们将由衷感激。」

paragraphs.en: Unsurprisingly, this explanation didn’t put players’ minds at ease. If anything, it left them even more frustrated and somewhat confused, with some pointing out that training an AI model on the designs of Shift Up’s designers does them a disservice and even bastardizes the artistry behind all their hard work.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，这番解释并没有让玩家安心。恰恰相反，这只让他们更加沮丧和困惑；一些人指出，用Shift Up设计师的作品训练AI模型，不仅会损害这些设计师的利益，甚至会糟蹋他们辛苦工作背后的艺术。

paragraphs.en: EVIE, the character at the heart of this video, was created from head to toe by our talented artists and modelers through more than a year of dedicated work.
paragraphs.cn: EVIE是这支视频的核心角色，由我们才华横溢的艺术家和建模师经过一年多的专心工作，从头到脚打造而成。

paragraphs.en: The AI is not creating her from scratch. It is rendering and presenting the character based on the data, designs, and…
paragraphs.cn: AI并非从零创造她，而是基于数据、设计以及……对这个角色进行渲染与呈现。

paragraphs.en: “The AI is doing your character a disservice, distorting her appearance, and in turn, making your team's art look bad, when in reality, they're so talented,” one fan wrote on X. “I would rather have fewer, shorter cinematics of your characters made by animators than hours of uncanny AI generations.”
paragraphs.cn: 一名粉丝在X上写道：「AI正在损害你们的角色，扭曲她的外貌，反过来也让你们团队的美术作品显得糟糕，可实际上你们都非常有才华。我宁愿看到动画师制作的角色过场动画更少、更短，也不想看上数小时诡异的AI生成内容。」

paragraphs.en: “That’s the issue though, it does not look like her a lot of the time, even if they might use the base model as part of the input. You're diminishing the quality of your own work, the brand, the studio, and Evie as a character,” another argued .
paragraphs.cn: 另一人反驳道：「问题就在这里：即使他们可能把基础模型作为输入的一部分，很多时候生成的内容也不像她。你们正在降低自身作品、品牌、工作室以及伊薇这个角色的质量。」

paragraphs.en: “You also risk associating the brand with AI slop, even if that might be true or not. You risk being in a position where the game might have some amazing set pieces or city backdrops that designers and developers made, and people will dismiss it as AI-generated.”
paragraphs.cn: 「你们还可能让品牌与AI垃圾内容联系在一起，无论这种联系是否属实。你们可能陷入这样的境地：游戏中有设计师和开发者制作的精彩场景或城市背景，但人们会把它们当成AI生成的内容而一笔带过。」

paragraphs.en: It’s worth noting that this is merely a music video promoting Stellar Blade: Blood Rain and not the game, itself. However, Hyung Tae has previously remarked on AI in reference to Korea’s competition with China in the gaming space, claiming Shift Up doesn’t have the manpower to compete with Chinese studios.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，这只是一支宣传《剑星：Blood Rain》的音乐视频，并不是游戏本身。不过，Hyung Tae此前曾在谈及韩国与中国的游戏行业竞争时评论过AI，称Shift Up没有足够人手与中国工作室竞争。

paragraphs.en: "80% of our company's revenue comes from overseas, and when we go abroad, the first opponent we encounter is Chinese games. We pour about 150 people into a single game, but China invests 1,000 to 2,000. We lack the capability to compete in terms of the quality or quantity of content,” he said back in January, per GameMeca .
paragraphs.cn: 据GameMeca报道，他今年1月曾说：「我们公司80%的收入来自海外，而当我们走向海外时，遇到的第一个对手就是中国游戏。我们会为一款游戏投入约150人，但中国投入的是1000至2000人。无论内容质量还是数量，我们都缺乏竞争能力。」

paragraphs.en: "I do not think people will lose their jobs even if AI becomes widespread. Even if we mobilize all available manpower, it will not be enough, and I believe that we can only barely compete with industries like China or the United States that require massive workforce deployments if all these people are proficient in AI and one person can perform the role of 100."
paragraphs.cn: 「即使AI普及，我也不认为人们会失去工作。即使调动所有可用人手也不够；我认为，只有当所有人都熟练使用AI、一个人能够完成100个人的工作时，我们才勉强有可能与中国或美国这样需要大规模人力投入的行业竞争。」

paragraphs.en: What’s more, Hyung Tae predicted a future where AI is central to the games industry, pointing out how quickly young people are picking it up as an essential tool in daily life.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，Hyung Tae预言AI将成为游戏行业的核心，并指出年轻人正迅速将其掌握为日常生活中的必备工具。

paragraphs.en: "(Korea's) ChatGPT paid subscription rate ranks second after the United States. The new generation is natural to AI. I believe that AI is the future of the younger generation and can become a new vision applicable to industry."
paragraphs.cn: 「（韩国的）ChatGPT付费订阅率仅次于美国，位居第二。对新一代来说，AI是很自然的事。我相信AI就是年轻一代的未来，也能成为适用于行业的新愿景。」

paragraphs.en: The Stellar Blade games themselves are no stranger to controversy, with Hyung Tae most recently addressing the debate that cropped up around Evie’s youthful design following Blood Rain’s reveal at Summer Game Fest. Given how sexualized Eve was in Stellar Blade, players were worried about how Evie might be perceived by some fans.
paragraphs.cn: 《剑星》系列游戏本身也并不缺少争议。最近，Blood Rain在夏日游戏节公开后，围绕伊薇年轻化设计的讨论就由Hyung Tae出面回应。考虑到伊芙在《剑星》中被塑造得相当性感，玩家担心部分粉丝会如何看待伊薇。

paragraphs.en: Speaking with IGN , the Shift Up CEO promised that “if you actually play the game, you will not think that,” telling us that, when combined with her scrappy nature and other features, players will “see that she’s a very lovable character.”
paragraphs.cn: 这位Shift Up首席执行官在接受IGN采访时保证，「如果你真的玩过游戏，就不会这么想」，并告诉我们，结合伊薇不服输的性格和其他特征后，玩家会「看到她是一个非常讨人喜欢的角色」。
